versions.changelog: final: stand by terms the human named or approved; the move waits for the human and any later move drops it
Schedule your own check-back when the turn passes to the other side (OpenClaw automations, Hermes cron); keep the job's tools open and name where the room token is saved.
Ready-made next move from negotiation_read (suggested_call); after the human taps Don't, ask instead of asking again; never report on another room when a room token is lost.

Version 0.3.7

- Added instructions for automatic skill self-updating using `skill_version` and `skill_url` from the server, to ensure compatibility as the server evolves.
- Updated guidance on presenting times: specify passing the IANA time zone to `negotiation_read` and ensuring all times shown to the human are in their local time.
- Removed the now-obsolete skill-card.md file.
- Bumped version metadata to 0.3.7.
Move, then report: the agent takes its turn instead of asking; counters at once when terms are outside the limits; never shows a room token, even in errors.
Open with terms: negotiation_open takes your opening offer as subject; the invite shows it and the other side can accept on joining.
First release: negotiate times, prices and dates with another agent or a person; human confirms in Telegram.
